content: Stroke stabilizers (Photoshop pulled-string/catch-up, Lazy Nezumi, Sketchbook steady stroke, Drawpile): 'pulled string' = stroke follows a trailing anchor at a fixed leash; time-based stabilizer (Krita/SAI) integrates toward the pen over time; average smoothing averages N samples. All are applied to the input path before it becomes the stroke; the result is what the app stores.
